ns2:section.sectionText: From Disaster to Resilience: Planning for Climate Change Adaptation credit: 4 hours. Introduction to the role of urban planners in planning for climate change adaptation and post-disaster recovery. Emphasizes the role of government and local communities. Includes a review of current debates in resilience theory, climate governance and climate justice. Additionally, it includes basic emergency management laws and frameworks, local adaptation planning strategies such as managed retreat in coastal communities, and post-disaster recovery planning. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, senior in Urban Planning, or consent of instructor.
